summary: Move the familiar point through a transparent cube model and read KEEP or REMOVE at one of twenty-seven first-level cells; the same address is framed on the large sponge. Reconstruct the selection with three nested loops and a Boolean function, retaining fewer than two middle coordinates. Use a separate next list to repeat the rule twice, predicting twenty then four hundred cubes, decreasing volume and fixed outer bounds. Make and test a corner-only variation. Enter the existing flight enclosure to distinguish a visible opening from one a body can use, then carry the difference between a rule and its spatial representation into Golden Spiral.
